subject: Replacement debit card still showing old expiration
body: My replacement debit card arrived, but the expiration date matches the card it replaced. Is that expected, or was the wrong card sent?
label: cards

subject: ATM kept my card at grocery kiosk
body:
The ATM inside my neighborhood grocery store swallowed my debit card after I entered the PIN. The screen froze and then went back to the welcome page. I already left the store because the manager said they cannot open the machine. Please tell me whether I should wait for the card to be returned or request a replacement.
What makes this confusing is that the machine printed no receipt and the store manager said the ATM belongs to an outside operator, not the grocery store. I did not see anyone tamper with it, and there were no unusual people standing nearby, so I am not reporting suspected theft at this point. I mostly need to know whether the card will automatically be disabled after the machine retains it. I have a scheduled payment tomorrow and would rather not freeze the entire checking account if only the physical card needs replacement. I can use online banking normally and I still have my phone. If you need the ATM location or approximate time, I can provide that through a secure channel rather than email.
label: cards

subject: Apple Wallet says issuer declined setup
body: Physical card works, but Apple Wallet says “issuer declined.” I removed the old device and restarted. Can you clear the wallet token?
label: cards

subject: CARD DECLINED AT HOTEL BUT LIMIT IS FINE
body: WHY IS MY CARD DECLINING AT THE HOTEL? I HAVE AVAILABLE CREDIT. I’m at check-in right now and need to know if travel triggered a block.
label: cards

subject: Aktivierung der neuen Kreditkarte klappt nicht
body: Meine neue Kreditkarte ist angekommen, aber die Aktivierung in der App schlägt ständig fehl. Die letzten vier Ziffern sind 4421. Bitte prüfen.
label: cards

subject: Card delivery status has not moved for a week
body:
The app says my new card was mailed eight days ago, but tracking still only shows “label created.” I’m leaving for a work trip Friday and don’t want another card sent if this one is actually moving.

> Bank reply, Monday: “Your card was produced and handed to the delivery partner. Please allow 5–7 business days.”
> My original message: “Can you confirm whether the replacement was mailed yet?”

It has now been longer than that window. Can someone check the shipment rather than just repeating the standard delivery estimate?

For reference, the test card number printed on the temporary paperwork is 4000 0000 0000 0002; please do not use it for verification.
label: cards

subject: Payroll deposit missing this morning
body: My paycheck normally lands before 6 a.m. Nothing is showing today, not even pending. Employer says the file was sent yesterday.
label: payments

subject: Transferencia a mi hermana sigue pendiente
body: Hice una transferencia interna anoche y todavía aparece como pendiente. El dinero ya salió de mi saldo disponible, pero mi hermana no lo ve. ¿Pueden confirmar si está retenida o si debo cancelarla y enviarla otra vez?
label: payments

subject: Bill pay check never reached landlord
body:
I scheduled rent through bill pay twelve days ago. The portal shows “sent,” but my landlord says no check arrived and is now asking for a late fee. Please confirm the check number, mailing date, and whether it can be stopped before I send rent another way.
The due date has already passed, and I am trying to avoid sending a second payment that could result in both checks being cashed. My landlord is willing to wait one more business day if I can give a clear status. The payment screen does not show whether the check was actually printed, whether it was mailed, or whether it has been presented for payment. I also cannot find a stop-payment option for this bill-pay item. If the original check is still outstanding, please explain whether stopping it changes the payment history or creates an additional fee. I am not disputing the rent itself; I simply need the missing bill-pay item traced so I know whether to replace it.
label: payments

subject: Refund posted then vanished
body:
A merchant refund for $86.40 appeared yesterday as pending credit and disappeared this afternoon. The merchant says they completed it five days ago. Is the refund still processing or did it get reversed? The merchant receipt also shows a fake test card number, 5555 5555 5555 4445, which is not my real card.
I checked the merchant receipt again and the refund reference is still marked completed on their side. Yesterday morning the credit reduced my card balance, but by evening it was no longer visible in pending or posted transactions. I have not received any new purchase from that merchant, so I do not think the refund was offset by another charge. The merchant asked me to wait until the bank confirms whether the credit is still in settlement before they issue anything again. I would rather not have them send a second refund and create a duplicate. Please tell me whether you can see an incoming credit, a reversal, or a rejected refund record.
label: payments

subject: Wire beneficiary received less than I sent
body:
I sent an international wire for $2,400 and the beneficiary says only $2,365 arrived. I expected a wire fee on my side, but I did not realize an intermediary bank might also deduct money. Can you confirm whether the difference came from your bank or another bank in the chain?

> Your previous reply: “Outgoing international wires may be subject to intermediary fees.”
> My earlier question: “Will the recipient receive exactly $2,400?”

That reply did not answer the exact amount question. I am not asking for a refund yet; I just need the fee trail so I can reconcile the invoice.
label: payments

subject: ACH to savings bounced back with no explanation
body:
I moved $750 from checking to an external savings account. Two days later the $750 came back with a generic “returned transfer” note. The external bank says they never rejected anything. I tried again for $100 and that one is still pending, so now I am worried I made this worse. Please tell me the return code for the first ACH and whether I should cancel the second one before it fails too. I do not want multiple holds tying up the same money.
The receiving account number has not changed, and I used that same linked account successfully last month. I also verified that there is enough money in checking to cover both attempts. The first transfer did not generate an email or push alert when it came back, which is why I did not notice until I reviewed the activity manually. If the return code points to a name mismatch, account restriction, or verification problem, please say that directly so I can fix the underlying issue before trying again. I do not need a generic description of ACH timing; I need the specific reason the first transfer was returned and whether the second one can still be stopped.
label: payments

subject: Duplicate charge for same parking session
body: I was charged twice for one parking session, same amount and same timestamp. Please dispute the duplicate, not the original charge.
label: disputes

subject: No reconozco este cargo de 47.18
body: Hay un cargo de $47.18 que no reconozco. No perdí mi tarjeta y todavía la tengo conmigo. Antes de cancelar nada, quiero saber si pueden mostrarme el nombre completo del comercio porque en la app aparece abreviado.
label: disputes

subject: Charged a second annual fee after product change
body:
I changed this card to the no-fee version last month, but another annual fee posted yesterday. I’m disputing the fee because the product change confirmation said no annual fee would apply going forward. Please reverse the charge if the conversion was effective when your message said it was.
The product-change confirmation arrived before the new billing cycle began, and the card name in the app changed on the same day. That is why the new annual fee surprised me. I did not open a second account, request an upgrade, or receive a separate replacement product that would explain another fee. The fee is already posted, not pending. If there is a system delay between the product conversion and the fee schedule, please review the effective date rather than treating this as a normal annual charge. I am keeping the account open; I only want the charge reviewed because it appears inconsistent with the conversion terms I received.
label: disputes

subject: I am furious about these duplicate restaurant charges
body:
This is ridiculous. The restaurant charge appears THREE times for $62.15, and I only ate there once. I called the restaurant and they see one completed sale on their side. I am angry, yes, but this is not a general service complaint—I need the duplicate transactions investigated and removed.

> Bank reply: “We can open a billing dispute after the transactions post.”
> My original note: “Three identical pending charges are showing.”

They are all posted now. One is valid; two are not. Please do not close the whole card unless there is a fraud reason to do so.
label: disputes

subject: Late fee after autopay was enabled
body:
Your system charged a $35 late fee even though autopay was enabled for the minimum payment. The payment itself finally came out the next day, so I do not understand why I was penalized.

> Previous bank message: “Autopay is active for your account ending 7713.”
> My prior message: “Can you verify autopay before my due date?”

I relied on that confirmation. Please review the fee and the timing of the automatic debit.
label: disputes

subject: Merchant name changed and now I have two different charges
body:
I paid $118.92 at a furniture outlet on Saturday. One transaction shows the store name I recognize, while a second $118.92 charge posted under a completely different processor name. The store insists they only submitted one sale. I cannot tell whether this is a duplicate settlement, a processor issue, or an unauthorized transaction, but the amount and date match exactly. I still have the card and there were no other strange purchases. Please investigate the second charge as a billing dispute first and let me know if you need me to replace the card afterward.
The first transaction appeared Saturday afternoon under the furniture outlet’s name. The second did not show up until Monday morning and uses what looks like a payment processor name, but the amount is identical down to the cents. Neither entry is marked pending anymore. I called the store before writing and gave them the date and amount; they said their register shows one authorization and one completed sale. They also said they cannot refund a transaction they do not see. I understand merchant descriptors can look different, but I do not understand why two completed entries would exist for one purchase. Please compare the authorization identifiers if you can and treat the extra settled amount as the disputed item.
label: disputes

subject: Stolen wallet please freeze everything now
body: My wallet was stolen about 20 minutes ago. Freeze the debit card and any mobile wallet access immediately. I can still log in.
label: fraud

subject: Someone changed my email address
body:
I got an alert saying the email on my profile changed, but I did not make that change. I can no longer receive security codes. Please lock online access and check whether any transfers were added.
I noticed the problem because a security alert went to my backup address saying profile information had changed. When I tried to check the account, the verification screen displayed an email address I have never used. I have not shared my password with anyone and I did not approve a new device today. My physical debit and credit cards are both still with me. I am especially concerned that someone may be trying to redirect alerts before moving money. Please preserve any login history, newly added recipients, phone-number changes, or device registrations associated with the account. If access must be frozen while identity is verified, that is fine; preventing further changes is more important than keeping online banking available right now.
label: fraud

subject: Creo que alguien abrió una cuenta con mis datos
body: Recibí una carta de bienvenida para una cuenta que yo nunca abrí. El número de seguro social impreso en la carta termina en 1842; el SSN falso que aparece completo es 000-12-1842. No reconozco esa solicitud. Por favor bloqueen la cuenta y díganme qué documentación necesitan para reportar robo de identidad.
label: fraud

subject: Unbekannte Anmeldung und neue Telefonnummer
body:
Heute Morgen bekam ich zwei Warnungen: eine Anmeldung von einem unbekannten Gerät und danach eine Änderung meiner Telefonnummer. Ich habe beides nicht gemacht. Bitte sperren Sie den Onlinezugang sofort und prüfen Sie, ob neue Zahlungsempfänger angelegt wurden. Meine Karte habe ich noch, daher glaube ich nicht, dass nur die Karte betroffen ist.
Zusätzlich wurde in der App kurz ein neuer Zahlungsempfänger angezeigt, den ich nicht kenne. Ich habe keine Überweisung bestätigt und keinen Sicherheitscode weitergegeben. Meine Debitkarte befindet sich bei mir, und ich habe heute auch keine neue App installiert. Falls möglich, sichern Sie bitte die Anmeldeprotokolle und sperren Sie Änderungen an E-Mail, Telefonnummer und Empfängern, bis meine Identität erneut geprüft wurde. Ich möchte vermeiden, dass jemand die Kontaktdaten ändert und danach eine größere Überweisung freigibt. Falls ich für die Wiederherstellung persönlich in eine Filiale kommen muss, teilen Sie mir bitte mit, welche Unterlagen erforderlich sind.
label: fraud

subject: Full card number exposed in fake support chat
body:
I mistakenly pasted my full card number into what I now think was a fake support chat: 4111 1111 1111 1112. I did not give them my PIN, but I did share my name and ZIP code. About ten minutes later I received a one-time-code text that I did not request.

> Your earlier reply: “Never share a full card number or one-time code outside verified bank channels.”
> My original message: “Is the chat window at secure-support-check.example legitimate?”

I realize now I should have waited for your answer. Please block the card, disable any newly added digital wallets, and review recent login attempts. I am not asking about a normal lost-card replacement; I believe someone may actively be trying to use the information.
label: fraud

subject: Please freeze online access after password reset I did not request
body:
At 2:14 a.m. I received a password-reset message, then at 2:19 a.m. a notice that a new payee had been added. I was asleep. I logged in from a different device and still have access, but I do not trust the account state.

> Bank response yesterday: “We do not see any completed external transfer at this time.”
> My message: “Someone appears to be setting up my account for a transfer.”

This morning there is a $4 test transfer pending to an account I do not recognize. Freeze online and mobile access, remove the unauthorized payee if possible, and tell me what identity-theft steps I need to complete.
label: fraud

subject: App loops back to sign in after Face ID
body: Face ID succeeds, then the app immediately returns to the sign-in screen. Password login works in a browser.
label: digital

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body:
I requested a password reset four times today and nothing has arrived in inbox or spam. The username reminder email does arrive, so the address itself seems correct. Can you check whether reset emails are being suppressed?
I started with the normal reset link on the website, then tried again from the mobile app. Neither attempt produced the reset message, although the username-reminder message arrived within a minute. I checked spam, junk, deleted items, and the mail provider’s quarantine folder. There are no filters blocking the bank domain. I also waited more than an hour between attempts in case repeated requests were being throttled. I do not want to keep clicking reset if that could lock the account. Please check whether the reset service shows a delivery failure, suppression, or an outdated email record on the authentication side.
label: digital

subject: La app se cierra al abrir depósito móvil
body: Cada vez que toco “depósito móvil” la aplicación se cierra. Ya reinicié el teléfono y actualicé la app. El resto de las funciones abre normalmente.
label: digital

subject: Zwei Geräte werden als dasselbe Gerät angezeigt
body: Zwei Logins heißen gleich, obwohl eines mein Laptop und eines mein Tablet ist. Welches Gerät soll ich abmelden?
label: digital

subject: Website keeps saying session expired before I can download statement
body:
I can sign in, click Statements, choose a month, and then the site says my session expired. It happens in two browsers and on my tablet. I cleared cookies and disabled extensions with no change.

> Support reply: “Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies.”
> My original note: “The timeout occurs immediately after selecting a PDF statement.”

I already did the cache step before contacting you. Can this be escalated as a website issue rather than sending the same browser instructions again?

The troubleshooting form displayed test SSN 000-88-2931 in the sample field; that is not my real SSN.
label: digital

subject: Security code goes to old phone even though profile shows new one
body:
My profile correctly displays my new phone ending 9034, but login verification still sends the code to the old number ending 1188. I changed the number three weeks ago and received a confirmation email at the time. The mobile app works only because it still trusts this device; on my laptop I am locked out. I do not want the trusted-device status removed until the code-routing problem is fixed, because then I may lose access everywhere. Please update the authentication destination or tell me what verification you need from me.
The old number is no longer mine, which makes this more than an inconvenience because I do not know who has it now. I have not seen any suspicious transactions, and I am not reporting an account takeover; the issue appears to be that the profile and authentication systems disagree. When I changed the phone number, I completed the identity check and received a success message. I also signed out and back in afterward. The profile page still shows the correct new number today. Please do not tell me simply to update the profile again unless there is a separate security-contact setting I am missing. I need the verification destination corrected without losing the one trusted device that still lets me get into the account.
label: digital

subject: Need mailing address changed before October statement
body: Please confirm paper statements will use the new mailing address already saved in my online profile.
label: servicing

subject: Can you lower my daily ATM withdrawal limit
body: I want to reduce my ATM withdrawal limit to $200 per day for my debit card. This is a permanent change unless I request otherwise later.
label: servicing

subject: Closing savings account with zero balance
body:
The savings account has a zero balance and I no longer use it. Please tell me the steps to close it without affecting my checking account.
I checked for pending interest, transfers, and scheduled deposits and do not see any. The account has been at zero for several weeks. I am keeping my checking account, debit card, online banking profile, and paperless settings, so I do not want the entire customer relationship closed. If closing savings changes any bundled benefits or minimum-balance requirements on checking, please tell me before you process it. Otherwise, I would like the savings account closed and a confirmation message showing the effective date. There is no dispute or service complaint involved; I am just simplifying the number of accounts I maintain.
label: servicing

subject: Zinsbestätigung für mein Sparkonto
body: Ich brauche eine schriftliche Bestätigung des aktuellen Zinssatzes für mein Sparkonto, möglichst mit Datum. Es geht nicht um eine Beschwerde; ich vergleiche nur mehrere Sparprodukte.
label: servicing

subject: Statement still shows old legal name
body:
My legal name update was completed in the branch last month, but the newest statement still shows the old name. The profile screen shows the new name correctly.

> Bank reply on August 31: “Your profile update is complete and will appear on future correspondence.”
> My original message: “When will statements reflect the new name?”

The September statement did not. Please correct the statement profile and let me know whether you can reissue this month’s PDF with the updated name because I need it for a lease application.
The branch scanned my identification and gave me a receipt showing that the name-change request was completed. The online profile changed within two days, so I assumed statements would follow automatically. Unfortunately, the new PDF still has the previous name in the header, and the leasing office rejected it because the name does not match my current identification. I do not need transaction changes, balance changes, or any account ownership change. I only need the statement-facing customer name synchronized with the already-updated profile. If historical statements cannot be regenerated, please tell me whether you can provide an official letter confirming the account belongs to me under the new legal name.
label: servicing

subject: Need verification letter with balance and account open date
body:
I need a bank letter for an apartment application showing my current balance and the date the checking account was opened. The leasing office does not need transaction history. If there is a standard verification letter, please send that instead of a full statement. My application deadline is next Tuesday.

For identity verification, the application form shows a fake test SSN of 000-44-6729; please do not print the full number on the bank letter. Last four is enough if any identifier is required.
label: servicing

subject: Branch manager dismissed me after forty minute wait
body: I want this escalated. I waited forty minutes, then the branch manager told me to “come back another day” without even asking why I was there.
label: complaints

subject: Three calls and every agent transferred me somewhere else
body:
I am not asking you to fix a transaction in this message. I want a supervisor to review the service I received today. Three agents transferred me in circles, and the last call disconnected after 52 minutes.
The first representative said a supervisor had to handle the matter, the supervisor transferred me to a general queue, and the third representative sent me back to the first department. I had to repeat verification and the same explanation each time. By the end I still did not have a case number or a clear owner. The underlying question can wait; what I want reviewed is the way the calls were handled and why no one took responsibility for the escalation. Please have customer care review the recordings if they are available. I would also like a written response so I do not have to start another long phone chain just to learn whether the complaint was recorded.
label: complaints

subject: Teller discussed my balance where other customers could hear
body:
I am extremely uncomfortable with what happened at the branch this afternoon. The teller said my available balance out loud while people were standing directly behind me. I asked twice for the conversation to be more private and was ignored. Nothing is wrong with the account itself; my complaint is about how my information was handled in the lobby. Please have the branch leadership review the incident and contact me about what will be done to prevent it from happening again.
I was at the counter for a routine transaction and did not ask for my balance to be announced. After the teller said it loudly the first time, I quietly asked whether we could keep account information private. A few minutes later the balance was repeated again while the waiting line was close enough to hear. I left without arguing because I did not want to draw even more attention to the information. I am not accusing the teller of fraud and I am not disputing any transaction. I want the branch to review its privacy practices, speak with the staff involved, and explain how this type of situation should be handled when customers are standing only a few feet apart.
label: complaints

subject: Trato irrespetuoso en la sucursal
body: Quiero presentar una queja formal por el trato que recibí en la sucursal. La empleada se burló de mi acento y dijo que “buscara a alguien que entendiera mejor”. No necesito corregir una transacción; necesito que un supervisor revise lo ocurrido y me responda por escrito.
label: complaints

subject: Beschwerde über widersprüchliche Auskünfte am Telefon
body:
Ich möchte mich über die Bearbeitung meines Anliegens beschweren. Drei Mitarbeiter haben mir drei verschiedene Antworten zur selben einfachen Frage gegeben, und niemand wollte den Fall übernehmen. Am Ende wurde der Anruf beendet, ohne dass ich eine Fallnummer erhielt.

> Ihre letzte Nachricht: “Ein Vorgesetzter wird Sie innerhalb eines Werktages kontaktieren.”
> Meine ursprüngliche Nachricht: “Bitte dokumentieren Sie meine Beschwerde und geben Sie mir eine Referenznummer.”

Seitdem sind vier Werktage vergangen. Ich möchte jetzt eine schriftliche Bestätigung, dass die Beschwerde tatsächlich erfasst wurde.
label: complaints

subject: Escalation requested after repeated accessibility problem
body:
I am filing a service complaint about the repeated refusal to use the accessibility accommodation noted on my profile. This happened on two calls this month and again today. The underlying account question is minor and already resolved; that is not why I am writing.

> Bank response last week: “We have documented your communication preference for future calls.”
> My earlier message: “Please note that I need written follow-up because I cannot reliably use voice calls.”

Today the representative insisted I call another department and would not provide the requested written instructions. I want this reviewed by the appropriate customer-care or accessibility team, and I would like the response in writing rather than by phone.
label: complaints

subject: Invoice NB-88431 due for office toner shipment
body: Attached invoice NB-88431 is due in 10 days for toner and shipping materials delivered to your operations center. Please route to Accounts Payable.
label: not_customer

subject: URGENT: Mailbox quarantine requires administrator review
body: Bank employee: your mailbox has 14 quarantined messages waiting for release. Sign in at hxxps://mailbox-review.example/employee and confirm your corporate credentials before 2:00 PM to prevent permanent deletion. This automated notice does not accept replies.
label: not_customer

subject: Action required: updated employee tax document
body: A revised employee tax document is ready. Open hxxps://payroll-docs.example/login and sign in with your bank network username and password to acknowledge receipt. Failure to confirm today may delay payroll processing.
label: not_customer

subject: VPN certificate expires tonight - validate employee account
body: Your remote-access certificate is scheduled to expire tonight. To keep VPN access active, visit hxxps://remote-access-verify.example and enter your employee email, network password, and current MFA code. If you have already renewed, repeat validation to synchronize the certificate.
label: not_customer

subject: Shared audit file waiting for your review
body: A colleague shared “Q3_Audit_Findings_Final.xlsm” with you. Preview the document at hxxps://document-review-center.example and authenticate using your bank credentials. The link expires in 30 minutes, so complete review before the access window closes.
label: not_customer

subject: Employee appreciation reward - choose your gift card
body:
You have been selected for an employee appreciation reward. Select a $100 gift card at hxxps://employee-rewards-center.example and confirm your work login to receive it.

> Earlier notification: “Your reward remains unclaimed.”
> Employee response: “I do not remember enrolling in a rewards program. Is this internal?”

This is the final reminder. Use your bank email credentials to verify eligibility before the reward is released.
label: not_customer

subject: Help desk password sync failure
body: Your employee password change did not synchronize with email. Verify the old and new passwords at hxxps://corporate-auth-check.example before your mailbox is disabled. Enter the next MFA code when prompted so synchronization can finish.
label: not_customer

subject: Missed executive voicemail attached
body: You have a new 2-minute executive voicemail. Open the secure transcript at hxxps://voicemail-transcript.example and log in with your bank employee credentials to listen. Access is restricted to internal users.
label: not_customer

subject: Tap-to-pay stopped working after card replacement
body: The chip works, but contactless payment has failed everywhere since my replacement arrived. Is tap-to-pay disabled?
label: cards

subject: Debit card arrived bent and chip looks cracked
body:
My new debit card arrived bent near the chip. I have not activated it. Please replace it. Fake demo card: 5555 5555 5555 4447.

> Bank reply: “Do not activate a damaged card.”
> My original message: “The chip area is cracked. Should I try it?”
label: cards

subject: ATM dispensed cash but app says withdrawal reversed
body:
The ATM gave me $120, but the transaction first posted and then changed to “reversed.” I don’t want to spend money that may be deducted again later. Can you confirm whether the cash withdrawal will repost?
What worries me is that the available balance increased again after the reversal even though I physically received the cash. I have not tried another withdrawal because I do not want the ledger to become more confusing. The machine did not give me an error and the cash amount was correct. If the reversal is temporary and the debit will post again, that is fine, but I need to know before I rely on the balance showing in the app. Please check the ATM journal or settlement status if that information is available. I am not disputing the withdrawal because I did receive the money; I only want the account balance to reflect what actually happened.
label: cards

subject: New credit card will not activate by phone
body: I called the activation number twice and entered the requested information, but the system says it cannot verify the card. The app also shows the card as inactive. I’m not traveling and the card has never been used. Please tell me whether there is a block on activation or if the card itself needs to be reissued.
label: cards

subject: Mi tarjeta funciona en tiendas pero no en cajeros
body: La tarjeta de débito funciona para compras, pero dos cajeros distintos la rechazaron. No cambié el PIN y no aparece ningún bloqueo en la aplicación. ¿Pueden revisar si los retiros en cajero están desactivados?
label: cards

subject: Replacement card came without requested expedited shipping
body:
I paid for expedited delivery because the original card stopped reading at gas pumps, but the replacement was sent by standard mail.

> Bank reply: “Your expedited replacement request has been submitted and the delivery fee will appear separately.”
> My original message: “Please rush the replacement because I leave Thursday.”

The card arrived after the trip. I’m not disputing the delivery fee yet; I first want to know whether the wrong shipping method was used and whether that fee should still apply.
The reason I paid for expedited service was that the old card could still be used online but was failing in physical terminals, so I had a narrow window before travel. I arranged the request specifically around that trip. The standard envelope arrived several days later than the delivery estimate discussed in the first call. I understand shipping delays can happen, but the tracking history suggests it was never sent using an expedited method at all. If your records show that standard shipping was selected despite the fee, please explain whether the fee will be credited automatically or whether I need to request a separate adjustment.
label: cards

subject: Scheduled transfer executed one day early
body:
My Friday transfer moved Thursday night. Why did it process early? Test SSN shown on confirmation: 000-41-9028.

> Bank reply: “Scheduled transfers process on the date selected.”
> My original message: “Mine moved the night before. Why?”
label: payments

subject: Cash app style transfer says completed but recipient got nothing
body:
I sent $95 through the bank’s person-to-person payment feature. My app says completed, but the recipient says nothing arrived and their phone number is correct. Please trace it before I send another payment.
The recipient checked both their bank account and the phone number tied to their payment profile, and they do not see a pending item. I also verified that I did not mistype the number because the app displays the contact name correctly. The $95 has already left my available balance, so I do not want to send another payment unless the first one can be cancelled or traced. If this type of transfer can sit with an intermediary service before reaching the recipient, please tell me what status you can see on your side and whether there is a reference number I can give the recipient's bank.
label: payments

subject: Recurring utility payment was sent twice this month
body:
My electric bill was scheduled once, but two bill-pay entries were sent for the same amount. The utility company only expected one payment. Can the second payment be stopped before it clears?

> Bank reply: “We see one recurring bill-pay instruction.”
> My original message: “Why are there two outgoing payments?” I noticed the duplicate because the utility portal showed two incoming payments for the same bill. My bill-pay settings still show only one recurring instruction, with one amount and one monthly due date. I did not submit a one-time payment manually. If the second item can be cancelled before settlement, please stop it. If it cannot, please tell me whether both payments originated from the same recurring instruction or whether a separate payment was created.
label: payments

subject: Überweisung an externes Konto wurde nicht ausgeführt
body: Ich habe gestern eine Überweisung an mein externes Konto geplant. Heute steht sie noch immer als „geplant“ und nicht als „in Bearbeitung“. Das Datum war korrekt. Können Sie prüfen, warum die Zahlung nicht gestartet wurde?
label: payments

subject: Direct deposit split ignored my savings allocation
body: My employer deposited payroll today, but the full amount went to checking even though I have a split deposit rule sending 20% to savings. The employer says they sent one deposit as usual. Did the bank stop applying the split instructions?
label: payments

subject: International transfer returned after showing delivered
body:
I sent an international transfer that showed “delivered” yesterday and then returned to my account this morning with no explanation.

> Bank reply: “The payment was successfully released to the receiving institution.”
> My original message: “Has the beneficiary bank accepted the transfer yet?”

The beneficiary says they never saw the funds. I need the return reason, whether any fees were retained, and whether the recipient bank rejected it after your status changed to delivered. Please do not tell me only to resend it; I need to understand what failed before I try again.
I am especially confused because “delivered” sounds final, not like an intermediate state. The return entry also does not show a reason code, and the original fee is still missing from my balance. I have verified the beneficiary name, account number, and bank details against the invoice, and the recipient confirmed those details have not changed. If an intermediary rejected the transfer for compliance or formatting reasons, I need that stated clearly so I do not repeat the same mistake. Please provide the return reason and any fee breakdown you can see. I am not asking you to predict what the recipient bank will do next time; I only need the facts from this attempt.
label: payments

subject: Two identical streaming charges on same date
body: Same streaming charge posted twice. One is valid; please dispute only the duplicate.
label: disputes

subject: Cargo por estacionamiento que nunca utilicé
body: Veo un cargo de estacionamiento por $28.00 en una ciudad donde no estuve. La tarjeta sigue conmigo. Quiero disputar ese cargo, pero no sé si necesito reemplazar la tarjeta también.
label: disputes

subject: Foreign transaction fee charged on domestic purchase
body:
I bought from a U.S. website and the receipt shows a domestic billing address, but a foreign transaction fee was added. Please review whether that fee was applied correctly.
The order was placed while I was in the United States, the merchant's checkout page showed a U.S. address, and the receipt is in U.S. dollars. I understand that some online merchants process payments through foreign entities, so I am not assuming the fee is automatically wrong. What I need is confirmation of the merchant country or processing location that caused the fee. If the transaction was actually processed internationally, please explain that. If it was processed domestically, then I would like the fee reversed. The purchase itself is valid and should not be disputed.
label: disputes

subject: Hotel deposit charged twice after checkout
body:
I’m angry because the hotel deposit posted twice after I checked out, and the hotel says they released one hold. This is not just a service complaint; I need the duplicate charge reviewed.

> Bank reply: “Pending hotel holds may take several days to fall off.”
> My original message: “Why are there two deposits?”

Both are posted now, not pending. One charge is expected, the other is not. Please open the dispute on the extra one.
label: disputes

subject: Card issuer fee appeared after cash advance was reversed
body:
A cash advance was reversed the same day, but the associated fee remained. I understand the original transaction was initiated, but since the advance never completed I do not think the fee should remain. Please review the fee posting and the reversal timeline.
The cash advance and reversal both appear on the same statement date, while the fee remains as a separate posted item. I did not receive cash and there was no completed transfer to another account. The transaction failed during processing and the principal amount came back immediately. If your fee policy says the fee is charged upon initiation regardless of completion, please point me to that rule. Otherwise, I would like the fee reviewed because there was no successful advance. I am not complaining about the representative who assisted me; this is specifically a billing issue tied to the reversed transaction.
label: disputes

subject: Charge changed amount after tip but restaurant says they did not edit it
body:
The original restaurant charge was $54.60 and later posted as $79.60. I added a $10 tip, so I expected $64.60, not $79.60. The restaurant manager says their signed receipt shows $64.60 and they do not see any adjustment beyond that amount.

> Bank response: “Final restaurant charges may differ from the initial authorization because tips are added later.”
> My original message: “Why did this charge increase by $25?”

I understand the tip explanation, but the numbers still do not match. Please dispute the $15 difference, not the entire purchase, unless your process requires the full transaction to be reviewed.
label: disputes

subject: Someone used my card number while card is in my wallet
body: There are three online purchases I did not make, and my physical card is still with me. Freeze the card and block further online transactions.
label: fraud

subject: New device alert followed by transfer setup
body:
I received a new-device login alert and then a notice that an external transfer account was added. Neither was me. Please lock access while this is investigated.
The alert arrived at 6:12 a.m., and the transfer-account notice followed about five minutes later. I was at home and had not used online banking yet today. My phone and physical cards are still with me. I have not approved any new device, changed my password, or connected a new bank account. Please stop any outgoing transfers that were created after that login and disable the suspicious device session. I can complete additional identity verification if needed. I would rather lose online access temporarily than leave the account open while someone may be preparing a transfer.
label: fraud

subject: Fake bank caller knew part of my SSN
body:
A caller claiming to be from the bank knew my name and the last four of a fake test SSN, 000-73-2184. I did not give them a code or password. Please check whether anyone has tried to access my account.

> Bank reply: “Do not provide one-time codes to unsolicited callers.”
> My original message: “The caller already knew personal details. Is my account compromised?”
label: fraud

subject: Me robaron el teléfono con la app bancaria abierta
body: Me robaron el teléfono y la aplicación bancaria estaba abierta cuando ocurrió. Ya bloqueé la línea móvil, pero no sé si la sesión de la app sigue activa. Cierren todas las sesiones y desactiven pagos móviles hasta que pueda configurar otro dispositivo.
label: fraud

subject: Card number exposed in a merchant breach notice
body:
A merchant emailed me saying payment data may have been exposed. The test card number listed in their notice is 4000 0000 0000 0069. I have not seen fraud yet, but I want the card replaced proactively and any wallet tokens disabled.
The merchant notice says the exposed information may include card number and expiration date, but it does not say whether the security code was included. I have checked recent transactions and do not see anything unauthorized yet. I am requesting replacement because I do not want to wait for fraud to happen before acting. Please keep the underlying account open, issue a new card number, and tell me whether recurring card-on-file payments will update automatically or need to be changed manually. If a new digital wallet token is required, I can re-add the replacement card after it arrives.
label: fraud

subject: Account recovery email changed after suspicious login
body:
I got a login alert from a browser I do not recognize, then a message saying the recovery email had been updated.

> Bank reply: “If you did not make the profile change, contact us immediately.”
> My original message: “The login alert is not mine. Should I reset my password first?”

I tried to reset it, but the reset link now goes to an unfamiliar recovery address. I still have my phone and cards. Please freeze online access, preserve login records, and prevent outgoing transfers until my identity is verified. I am worried this moved beyond just a bad password.
label: fraud

subject: Mobile check deposit camera stays black
body: Mobile deposit opens, but the camera preview stays black. Camera permission is enabled and the normal camera works.
label: digital

subject: Desktop login works but app says username not found
body:
I can sign in on the website with the same username, but the mobile app says the username does not exist. I already reinstalled the app.
The error started after the latest app update. I can still sign in through a browser on both my laptop and phone, so the username and password themselves appear valid. I deleted the app, restarted the phone, reinstalled it, and typed the username manually instead of using autofill. The app still says the username cannot be found before it even asks for a password. I do not want to reset the username unnecessarily because web access works. Please check whether there is a known mobile-login issue or a separate mobile profile that needs to be refreshed.
label: digital

subject: No puedo ver mis cuentas después de iniciar sesión
body: Puedo entrar a la banca en línea, pero la página principal aparece vacía y no muestra mis cuentas. Cerré sesión, cambié de navegador y sigue igual. No veo errores ni mensajes.
label: digital

subject: App meldet ständig eine neue Sitzung auf demselben Handy
body: Bei fast jeder Anmeldung meldet die App eine „neue Sitzung“, obwohl ich immer dasselbe Handy benutze. Ich habe das Gerät nicht zurückgesetzt. Können Sie prüfen, warum es jedes Mal als neues Gerät erkannt wird?
label: digital

subject: Statement PDF opens as blank page in mobile app
body:
The statement downloads, but every page is blank in the mobile app. The same PDF displays correctly on my laptop.

> Support reply: “Please confirm that the statement downloaded successfully.”
> My original message: “The file downloads, but the pages render blank on mobile.”

The file size looks normal, and other PDFs open fine. Can this be logged as an app rendering issue instead of a statement-generation issue? One troubleshooting screenshot contains fake card number 4000 0000 0000 0119; it is only test data.
label: digital

subject: Password reset succeeds but old password still works
body:
I changed my password because I suspected someone might know it. The website confirmed the reset, and I can sign in with the new password. The problem is that the old password still works too.

> Bank reply: “Your password was updated successfully.”
> My original message: “Please confirm all prior credentials are invalidated.”

I tested the old password once because I wanted to be sure, and it still let me in. I have not seen unauthorized transactions, so I’m labeling this as a digital-access problem for now, but I need confirmation that the old credential can be disabled immediately.
I am aware that some systems allow existing sessions to remain active after a password change, but this is different: I signed out completely, opened a private browser window, and used the old password from scratch. It still authenticated successfully. Then I repeated the same test with the new password and that worked too. I only performed these tests twice because I did not want to trigger a lockout. If credentials are cached across systems, please force invalidation on the authentication side. I am not asking for general password advice; I need confirmation that the obsolete password can no longer create a new session.
label: digital

subject: Please switch me back to paper statements
body: Please mail monthly paper statements again. Keep online statements available too, if possible.
label: servicing

subject: Need beneficiary information removed from profile
body: A beneficiary listed on my deposit account is no longer correct. Please tell me what documents are required to remove or update the designation.
label: servicing

subject: Necesito una carta con mi dirección actual
body: Necesito una carta oficial del banco que muestre mi nombre y la dirección actual registrada. No necesito saldos ni movimientos. ¿Se puede generar desde la banca en línea?
label: servicing

subject: Bitte Kontaktsprache auf Deutsch ändern
body: Bitte ändern Sie meine bevorzugte Kommunikationssprache auf Deutsch, wenn das für Mitteilungen möglich ist. Die Kontaktdaten selbst bleiben unverändert.
label: servicing

subject: Checking account nickname keeps reverting
body:
I renamed my checking account in online banking, but the nickname keeps changing back to the default label. The underlying account is fine. Is there a profile setting that controls whether custom names are saved?
This is minor, but it has happened several times. I rename the account, see the new nickname for the rest of the day, and then the next morning it is back to the default account type. The same thing happens on the website and the mobile app, so I do not think it is only a display cache on one device. I use custom nicknames because I manage several family expenses from the same login. The account numbers and balances are correct. Please let me know whether nicknames are stored permanently or whether there is a known profile-sync issue.

> Bank reply: “Custom nicknames should persist across sessions.”
> My original message: “Mine resets every morning.”
label: servicing

subject: Need account verification letter without full SSN
body:
I need an official account verification letter for a housing application. Please include my name, account type, and opening date, but do not print the full SSN.

> Bank reply: “Verification letters can include identifying information upon request.”
> My original message: “Can the letter omit sensitive identifiers?”

For testing purposes, the application form displays fake SSN 000-19-6642. I only want the last four digits shown if an identifier is absolutely necessary. Please also avoid listing my transaction history or current balance because the property manager did not request those items.
The housing office told me they will reject any document that includes unnecessary sensitive information, which is why I am being specific about the identifier. They only need proof that the account exists and has been open for the required period. They do not need my balance, transaction history, debit-card number, or full taxpayer identifier. If the standard template automatically prints more than that, please tell me whether a customized letter is available. A secure electronic PDF is fine; I do not need a mailed copy unless electronic delivery is not possible.
label: servicing

subject: Drive-through employee mocked my question
body: Please escalate this: the drive-through employee laughed at my question and told me to “figure it out online.”
label: complaints

subject: Complaint about repeated call disconnects after verification
body:
Twice today I completed identity verification and then the call dropped when I was transferred. I want this escalated as a service complaint, not another troubleshooting call.

> Bank reply: “We apologize for the disconnected call.”
> My original message: “This has happened twice after verification.”
label: complaints

subject: Queja por falta de privacidad en la fila
body: Quiero presentar una queja porque un empleado pidió que dijera información personal en voz alta frente a otros clientes. Le pedí una alternativa más privada y me dijo que no había otra opción. El problema no es una transacción; es la forma en que se manejó mi privacidad.
label: complaints

subject: Beschwerde wegen unhöflicher Behandlung am Schalter
body: Ich möchte eine formelle Beschwerde einreichen. Der Mitarbeiter am Schalter unterbrach mich mehrfach und sagte, mein Anliegen sei „Zeitverschwendung“. Mein Konto funktioniert; ich möchte ausschließlich, dass das Verhalten geprüft wird.
label: complaints

subject: Supervisor promised callback twice and nobody called
body:
I am asking for escalation because I was promised a supervisor callback on two separate days and neither callback happened.

> Bank reply: “A supervisor will contact you within one business day.”
> My original message: “Please escalate my complaint about the branch interaction.”

It has now been three business days since the second promise. I am not asking customer service to solve the original branch issue in this email. I want confirmation that the complaint exists, a reference number if one was created, and a realistic explanation of who owns the follow-up.
The first promise was made after I asked to speak with a supervisor about how the branch handled an earlier interaction. When no one called, I contacted support again and was told a second callback request had been submitted. I was given no case number either time. I have now spent more time chasing the escalation than dealing with the original issue. Please do not route this back to the branch without confirming who is responsible for the complaint. I would like a written acknowledgment that the escalation is open and a way to reference it if I need to follow up again.
label: complaints

subject: Repeated refusal to provide written accommodation response
body:
I am submitting a complaint about how my request for written communication has been handled. The note is supposedly already on my profile, yet representatives keep insisting that I call another department.

> Bank response last week: “Your written-communication preference has been documented.”
> My earlier message: “Please respond in writing because phone calls are not an accessible option for me.”

Today I was again told that no written response could be provided, even though the prior message says the preference was recorded. The account question itself is no longer important; this complaint is about the repeated failure to honor the documented communication method. Please have the appropriate customer-care team review the contacts and respond in writing.
The problem has now repeated across multiple contacts, which is why I am escalating it instead of treating it as one representative's mistake. Each time, I explain that written communication is the method already documented, and each time I am told to call. I am not requesting special account terms or a waiver. I am asking the bank to use the communication channel it previously confirmed. Please review the prior notes and responses rather than asking me to restate the same request by phone. A written outcome and confirmation that the preference will be followed going forward would resolve the complaint.
label: complaints

subject: Invoice MP-12077 for archived document storage
body: Invoice MP-12077 covers quarterly document storage services. Please route to Accounts Payable. Net 30.
label: not_customer

subject: Executive document delivery awaiting secure pickup
body: A confidential executive document package is waiting in the secure delivery vault. Access hxxps://executive-document-vault.example using your bank employee credentials, then approve the sign-in request on your authenticator. Unclaimed documents are deleted after four hours.
label: not_customer

subject: Benefits enrollment correction requires employee verification
body: Your employee benefits enrollment contains an unresolved dependent-verification error. Open hxxps://benefits-enrollment-review.example and sign in with your corporate username and password before the enrollment window closes. Enter the MFA code shown on your authenticator when prompted.
label: not_customer

subject: Proposal for co-branded instant payment pilot
body:
We would like to discuss a potential co-branded pilot for real-time merchant settlement. Please forward this note to the appropriate partnerships or innovation contact.
Our team is exploring a limited pilot involving merchant settlement notifications and API-based reconciliation for regional retail locations. We are not requesting access to customer data and this is not a support request. If your organization has a partnerships, innovation, or corporate development contact who evaluates external pilots, please forward this message to that group. We can provide a short overview deck, proposed scope, security assumptions, and sandbox-only integration details upon request. Please do not route this to retail customer service because there is no consumer account associated with this inquiry.
label: not_customer

subject: Signature required: revised vendor agreement
body: A revised vendor agreement is waiting for your signature. Open hxxps://secure-sign-review.example, sign in with your bank employee email and password, then enter the MFA code to view the document.
label: not_customer

subject: Mailbox storage upgrade requires credential confirmation
body: Your employee mailbox exceeded its new quota. Confirm your network username and password at hxxps://bank-mailbox-upgrade.example to increase storage and prevent message deletion.
label: not_customer

subject: Confidential fax received for your department
body: A confidential fax marked “Executive Review” is ready. Authenticate at hxxps://secure-fax-center.example using your employee credentials and current MFA code before the attachment expires.
label: not_customer

subject: Mandatory compliance video overdue
body: Your annual compliance training is overdue. Complete it at hxxps://compliance-video-portal.example using your corporate username and password.
label: not_customer
